skill.name: ai-sdk
skill.description: Helps developers build current Vercel AI SDK features by checking installed docs, source files, and official AI SDK references before giving implementation guidance.
skill.summary: Build AI SDK features with current docs, typed agents, streaming chat, and gateway guidance.
skill.author: vercel

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives caused by Markdown examples, inline code, public documentation URLs, environment variable placeholders, and relative imports. The confirmed concern is that SKILL.md can lead an assistant to install the ai package when local docs are missing, which may modify dependencies and fetch external code without explicit confirmation. No prompt injection, credential exfiltration, or malicious intent was found.

remediation.issue: Dependency installation guidance can run without explicit consent.
remediation.suggestion: Require clear user confirmation before running package manager commands or editing dependency files.

content.value_statement: AI SDK APIs change quickly, which can cause broken examples and outdated patterns. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code to verify docs and build current AI SDK features.
actual_capabilities: Finds current AI SDK APIs in installed package docs and source files.
Guides generateText, streamText, structured output, embeddings, and tool calling.
Helps build ToolLoopAgent agents and type-safe useChat interfaces.
Explains AI Gateway setup, model ID lookup, and provider selection.
Maps deprecated AI SDK patterns to current replacements.
Suggests framework-specific streaming and API route integration steps.
limitations: Requires project dependencies or online docs to confirm current APIs.
May suggest installing the ai package before local documentation is available.
Does not replace provider billing, account setup, or key management.
Examples depend on the AI SDK version present in the project.

use_cases.title: Add Streaming Chat
use_cases.description: Build a chat endpoint and client that follow current AI SDK useChat and stream response patterns.

use_cases.title: Modernize AI SDK Code
use_cases.description: Find deprecated options, renamed fields, and outdated examples after an AI SDK upgrade.

use_cases.title: Design Type-Safe Agents
use_cases.description: Plan ToolLoopAgent files, typed tools, and UI message types for a production agent workflow.

prompt_templates.title: Check API Usage
prompt_templates.prompt: I am using the AI SDK in a TypeScript app. Verify the current API for generateText and explain the minimal setup.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Chat Endpoint
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate implementation for an app route and client.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a streaming chat endpoint and matching useChat client for my Next.js app. Check the installed docs before choosing imports.

prompt_templates.title: Migrate Deprecated Patterns
prompt_templates.scenario: Upgrade review for existing AI SDK code.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my AI SDK code for deprecated options, especially maxTokens, maxSteps, tool parameters, and useChat transport changes.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Typed Agent
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced architecture for agent and UI type safety.
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a ToolLoopAgent with typed tools, typed UI messages, and a framework-specific streaming route. Call out required package installs.

output_examples.input: Fix my useChat type errors after upgrading the AI SDK.
output: Identifies deprecated input state and transport patterns.
Recommends current message sending and stream response behavior.
Lists files to adjust and a typecheck step to run.

output_examples.input: Build an agent that calls weather and calculator tools.
output: Proposes an agent and tool file layout.
Explains how to infer typed UI messages from the agent.
Notes how to render each typed tool state.

output_examples.input: Which model ID should I use with AI Gateway?
output: Checks the current gateway model list before recommending an ID.
Prefers the newest compatible model version.

best_practices: Verify local AI SDK docs and source before answering API questions.
Ask before installing packages or changing dependency files.
Run typecheck after edits involving AI SDK imports, tools, or React hooks.
anti_patterns: Do not rely on remembered model IDs or old AI SDK examples.
Do not mix deprecated useChat message handling with current typed tool parts.
Do not add provider packages until the project requirements need them.

faq.question: What does this skill help build?
faq.answer: It helps build AI SDK text generation, streaming chat, tools, agents, structured outputs, embeddings, and provider integrations.

faq.question: Does it work with Claude and Codex?
faq.answer: Yes. It is marked for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does it install dependencies?
faq.answer: It may suggest installing the ai package when local docs are missing. Confirm dependency changes before running them.

faq.question: Can it choose models?
faq.answer: It guides model selection through AI Gateway and asks the assistant to check current model IDs.

faq.question: What versions does it support?
faq.answer: It prioritizes installed AI SDK docs and source, then online docs for older or missing local documentation.

faq.question: Is it only for Next.js?
faq.answer: No. It asks the assistant to detect the project framework before implementing routes or clients.
